messages:
jason_sales: Heads-up 10x scale health customer (Zephyr) wants a formal quote for compliance add-ons tied to a 12mo $250k commit. ask: 7-year audit log retention, HSM/BYOK integration, and HIPAA attestation. they also asked if we can credit the one-time BYOK integration fee against the commit.

ameera_se: tagging infra & legal. need to surface ops constraints: long-term retention increases storage footprint and restore costs. also confirm log ingestion rate (they expect ~200MB/s peak).

talia_legal: HIPAA + BYOK both ok in principle. if BYOK = customer HSM, need explicit custody and access language. also require a security incident playbook and responsibility matrix before sign.

noah_dealdesk: Draft pricing options (pre-approval ranges):
- Base audit logs (30d): $0.018/GB-month
- Long-retain (7y) archival tier: $0.0045/GB-month
- Managed HSM: $1,800/month per tenant
- BYOK integration (customer HSM): $2,500 one-time + $700/month
- HIPAA package (attestation + BA + annual review): $3,000/year
Discount policy: up to 12% auto, 12-25% manager approval, >25% director.

infra_ops: ops note: for 7y retention we suggest tiered lifecycle: hot 90d, warm 2y, archive rest. if they want full restore SLAs for archived data that'll need additional infra SLA and charges. also BYOK integration windows are usually 2 weeks for testing + 1 week for cutover.

jason_sales: Zephyr wants the BYOK one-time waived and 12% off add-ons. they need a signed LOI by Thurs COB. can we expedite?

noah_dealdesk: For $250k commit, we can approve: 12% off add-ons + waive up to $1,250 of BYOK fee. Full waiver requires manager signoff. Alternative: offer full BYOK waiver if they extend to 18mo commit or increase to $350k.

talia_legal: If we waive fee we must add language: "Customer agrees to follow Redwood integration checklist and provides root-level HSM access hours during a scheduled window." Also include a clause for remediation/time-and-materials billing if scope changes.

security-bot: Reference: internal compliance playbook  https://internal.redwood.com/compliance/controls  includes HSM integration checklist and HIPAA SOW template.

ameera_se: Operational ask: include a contingency line in the quote: "Additional engineering integration beyond 40h billed at $160/hr." prevents open-ended work if BYOK environment is nonstandard.

jason_sales: OK i'll present: 12% discount + partial BYOK waiver ($1,250) + contingency hours clause. ask customer if they can accept the contingency and provide LOI by Thu.

noah_dealdesk: I'll queue manager approval now for a possible full waiver if they accept a minor price uplift elsewhere. If manager approves today I can route director sign-off same day.

talia_legal: I can turn around redlines for the BYOK waiver clause this afternoon; need confirm on data residency (they want US-only).

infra_ops: final note: if ingest exceeds 300MB/s we need to provision dedicated pipelines (one-time infra fee estimate: $6k). include as optional line item.

jason_sales: thanks everyone. i'll loop back with Zephyr and push for LOI. will update this thread with their response. :handshake:
